# YellowBird

> Documentation for YellowBird, a Go media pipeline. An upload is stored, a job id is published on Redis, and a separate worker runs FFmpeg.

The docs live at https://yellowbird.amaanworks.me/docs. The API origin is https://api.amaanworks.me. The Go module is https://github.com/dexisback/YellowBird.

## Docs

- [YellowBird docs](https://yellowbird.amaanworks.me/docs): What the pipeline does, and where the API, workspace, and cloud repos live.
- [Architecture](https://yellowbird.amaanworks.me/docs/architecture): Gin API and FFmpeg worker as separate processes. Postgres is the record. Redis Streams deliver job ids.
- [Workspace](https://yellowbird.amaanworks.me/docs/product): Next.js app for sign-in, upload, and renditions.
- [API](https://yellowbird.amaanworks.me/docs/api): HTTP routes, JWT, and the multipart upload body.
- [Workers](https://yellowbird.amaanworks.me/docs/workers): Redis consumer group, FFmpeg flags, and the dead-letter stream.
- [Cloud](https://yellowbird.amaanworks.me/docs/cloud): ECS Fargate, S3, and the GitHub Actions deploy role.
- [Run it](https://yellowbird.amaanworks.me/docs/run): Postgres, Redis, the API, and the worker on a local machine.

## Notes

There is no HLS playlist in the worker. A video upload creates a thumbnail, a 10 second preview, and H.264 MP4s at 360p, 720p, and 1080p.
